lines: Day one. I started a war in my Instagram comments. A hundred and twenty-four people showed up.
Every comment became a soldier, with a name and a post on the front.
Day four, three hundred. Day nine, six hundred.
Then, in a single day, almost eight hundred joined.
Day eleven. Almost two thousand soldiers. Three hundred and fifty-eight have already died.
Day twelve starts tomorrow. Comment Hegemony or Concord to join.
Mud and Iron. Free at mudandiron dot app.
